Title: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland
Address: Hyde Park, London (East Red Gate near Marble Arch and Bond Street, closest to Santa Land; South Blue Gate near Hyde Park Corner)
Subjects: Christmas, Funfair rides, Shows, Christmas market
ScheduleText: Every day 19 November 2026 – 3 January 2027 except Christmas Day, until 22:00. Opens 10:00 except some weekdays: 12:00 on 19–20 Nov, 23–26 Nov, 30 Nov and 2 Dec; 14:00 on 1 Dec; 11:00 on 27 Nov, 3–4 Dec, 7–11 Dec, 14–18 Dec and 28 Dec – 1 Jan. Book a date and arrival hour. 3 January is a Family Fun Day
PriceText: Entry per person (everyone needs a ticket): off-peak £1 (green slots; every Mon–Thu in November), standard £5.50, peak £8.25 (evenings and weekends). Booking fee included. Rides and Santa Land packages extra
Description: Huge Christmas fair with 150+ rides, shows and a market. Santa Land is the young children's area: a package gives unlimited goes on 16 family rides all day (children must be 1 m tall) plus a kids' meal deal
Pros: Off-peak entry almost free; Santa Land for little ones
Cons: Busy and expensive once inside; rides need 1 m height

Title: Christmas at Kew light trail
Address: Kew Gardens (entrances: Victoria Gate, Brentford Gate, Elizabeth Gate), Richmond
ScheduleText: Selected dates 13 November 2026 – 3 January 2027, 16:20–22:00 with timed entry. Last entry: Brentford Gate 19:00, Elizabeth Gate 19:20, Victoria Gate 20:00 (24 Dec: closes 21:00, last entry up to an hour earlier). Quiet Access sessions 21 Nov, 1, 16 and 26 Dec. Adult-only evenings 3 and 9 Dec
PriceText: From £25.50; family and child tickets available (prices in booking)
Description: Festive light trail through Kew Gardens with light installations, colour tunnels and music, a visit from Father Christmas, a traditional fairground and festive street food
Pros: Brentford Gate is close to Ealing; Quiet Access sessions
Cons: Pricey; no scooters, balance bikes or bikes on the trail; parking must be pre-booked
NeedsInfo: Event page read 2026-10-31; child and family prices only in the booking system
